data: Existing Binance 5m price and optional OI archives, September 2020 through August 2026
features: Prior completed price/flow bars; no trader-ratio dependencies; optional OI with training-only median imputation and explicit missing flags; longest lookback 289 completed bars
target: Actual untrimmed next-open / current-open minus one; tied/zero-return outcomes retained

model.direction: Standardized L2 logistic C=0.1, max_iter1000, seed42
model.magnitudes: Two conditional Ridge regressions alpha100 for positive and nonpositive return sizes using the same training-only preprocessing
model.calibration: Separate Platt direction C=1 and conditional magnitude scale ratios on subsequent two calendar months

updates.strict_label_availability: Each fit/calibration/admission partition requires target_end strictly earlier than next partition boundary

trade_rule.position_notional: 1x fixed initial notional diagnostic; no leverage optimization
trade_rule.admission: At least100 candidate trades on at least20 active days in separate admission month, and seven-day-block bootstrap95% lower net6bps expectation >0
trade_rule.shadow: Record ungated candidate diagnostics even when admission rejects; actionable signal stays flat

economics.fees: Applied to actual entry and exit notionals
economics.funding: Available Binance settled events with containing5m-open approximate mark; exact entry and exit-boundary events excluded
economics.entry_reference: Bar open optimistic reference, not executable bid/ask

preserve: All original v1 models, data, predictions, source code, audit, and previous result evidence
limitations: Already exposed historical data. One fixed repaired design; no post-result tuning or profitability confirmation. No live orders, deployment or account access. Actual quote latency, cross-venue transfer, margin, and funding differences remain unverified.
